brief:
Hamas denounced Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu's speech at the UN General Assembly as false and misleading, Middle East Eye reported. The group said his denial of "systematic genocide" contradicted findings from UN reports on the matter.

Hamas did not elaborate further on which specific claims in Netanyahu's address it considered inaccurate or provide additional context on the UN findings it referenced.
dek: Hamas denounces Netanyahu’s speech as ‘rife with lies’ Hamas denounced Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu’s address at the UN General Assembly as “rife with lies”, saying that his denial of the "systematic genocide” contradicts United Nations reports,…
title: Hamas calls Netanyahu's UN address a string of lies
